exceptions: fine or penalty ₹1.36 lakh: Employee State Insurance Corporation (The order was passed in respect to M/s. Cynosure Interface Services Private Limited, which merged with Zensar Technologi)

penalties.details: The order was passed in respect to M/s. Cynosure Interface Services Private Limited, which merged with Zensar Technologies Limited effective from April 1, 2021. The order is passed u/s. 45A of the ESI Act, 1948 for the period from June 2017 to July 2018 whereby the penalty has been re-assessed as Rs. 1,35,638/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty Five Thousand Six Hundred and Thirty Eight Only). Since the Company has already deposited 25% advance of Rs. 86,750/, the balance amount due and payable is Rs. 48,888/ - (Rupees Forty Eight Thousand Eight Hundred and Eighty Eight Only).
penalties.impact: Based on the Company’s assessment, the Company is of the opinion that there is no impact of the penalty on the financials of the Company

penalties.details: The Development Commissioner, Visakhapatnam Special Economic Zone, passed an Order imposing a penalty of Rs. 30,000 on Zensar Technologies Ltd under Section 11(2) of the Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992 for delay in filing of Softex Forms.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,450.4 Cr (+6.7% YoY), net profit ₹210.6 Cr (+19.4% YoY).
On April 24, 2026, Zensar Technologies announced the board approval for appointing Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditor for a five-year term starting from the 64th AGM.
Zensar Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,450.4 Cr and PAT of ₹210.6 Cr, alongside an order book of $401.8M.
Zensar Technologies released its FY26 investor presentation highlighting $643.7M revenue, 16.0% EBITDA margin, and $319.5M net cash.
Zensar Technologies received an ESG rating of 76 ('Leader') from NSE Sustainability Ratings for FY2026.
